layouts.description: Reference look of the current feature graphic: copy column left; 3–4 phones stepped to the right, receding in depth (dimmer, smaller behind).
One large phone, slight rotation, soft radial spotlight; copy beside (wide) or above (tall/square).
Two phones overlapping — front lower-left, back upper-right; copy top-left.
Three upright phones in a row, even spacing, no rotation; copy centred above. Tall: a broad, descending zigzag with overlapping lower edges.
Tilted cascade of 3 phones with increasing rotation/depth bleeding off the bottom edge.
One phone scaled past the canvas, anchored bottom, only the top ~60 % of the screen visible; very large 2-line headline.

Wallpaper background (blurred σ≈24, darkened 35 %) with the phone screen showing the same wallpaper sharp and canvas-aligned; wide/square canvases use the wide panorama, tall uses the portrait. Needs the matching wallet-<themeName> capture.
Album showcase: 3–5 phones with different wallpapers on the album hero's blurred background; copy above. Tall: balanced two-column rows, with a final single phone centred.
